project_type: Node.js Express service (Render deploy) — the public AI chatbot backend for the Chhath Puja portal. ESM modules, node:test unit tests.
build_system: npm (no bundler for the render service). PATH must PREPEND /root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin. Install with `npm ci`.
test_framework: node:test (built-in), test files named test/*.test.mjs, assertions via node:assert/strict. No jest.
verification_instructions: 1) export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH"  2) cd mgmt/server-render && npm ci  3) npm test — baseline is 203 pass / 0 fail. All new + existing tests must stay green.
snapshot_or_generated_files: none for the render service. (There is a docx golden fixture used by unrelated docxRender tests; not touched by this task.)
environment_constraints: CACHE-ONLY hard rule: publicData.js must NEVER add a new network fetch or D1/DB call. Every context builder operates purely on the already-cached `data` object passed in. Tests stub globalThis.fetch to throw and assert the builders never call it — keep that invariant. Do NOT change provider/model configuration in code (the model switch to gemini-3.1-flash-lite #1 is already live in D1 via AI Management). Do NOT touch Public/frontend-v6 (the widget is separate and out of scope).
contribution_requirements: Do NOT push or open a PR (the orchestrator publishes). Work on a NEW branch off origin/main (main tip is commit cabf5fe, PR #406). Keep the existing node:test suite green. Follow existing code style in publicData.js (defensive shapes: missing field -> ''/0, never throws; num()/inr() helpers; ID->name resolution with USER#### neutral-label degradation).
key_patterns: publicData.js builds the chatbot system-prompt context from the cached portalData payload. Three builders: summarizePortalData(data, question) [compact, SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS=6000], buildYearScopedContext(data, question, years) [when a known year is named], buildFullContext(data, question) [whole dataset, FULL_MAX_CHARS=80000, auto-degrades to summary over cap]. buildContextForProvider(provider, data, question, lang) selects full vs summary by provider.dataMode and currently appends ONE Hindi line when lang==='hi'. Helpers: num(), inr() (₹ + en-IN), buildNameResolver(users) (ID USER#### -> real name), the looksLikeRawId/safeName neutral-label degradation used at each person-ID call site, detectYears(question, knownYears). Shared preamble line NO_DEV_INSTRUCTIONS_LINE is pushed into every builder — keep it. Resold rows are excluded from contributor counts and carry a 'already counted in the year total' note to avoid double-count.
journey_data_source: CONFIRMED: the `?action=portalData` payload the Render service already fetches (Public/backend/src/index.js portalSections) carries journey data: `journeyEntries` = array of {year, title_en, title_hi, content_en, content_hi} (position-ordered story rows; [] on older backend), `journeyTagline` = {en, hi}, `journeyPageText` = {en:{...}, hi:{...}} static prose. The public frontend derives the Decade/'Our Journey' page from these PLUS computed figures in Public/frontend-v6/src/lib/api/derive.ts: DECADE_START_YEAR = 2017; decadeStats() builds per-year {total, contributors(resold excluded), isCurrent} from 2017 to max(2017, latest data year, current calendar year), plus grandTotal and grandContributors. So the chatbot journey section should be sourced from BOTH: (a) real journeyEntries/journeyTagline when present in `data`, and (b) always-available DERIVED decade figures (first year 2017, latest year, total across all years, best year, growth, contributor counts) computed from the cached collections/expenses — no new data source, cache-only.
